response.sql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as baseline_qty
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
),
order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg_qty
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT 
  order_id,
  order_avg_qty,
  order_avg_qty - (SELECT baseline_qty FROM baseline) as difference
FROM order_averages
WHERE (SELECT baseline_qty FROM baseline) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity values are numeric or castable to DECIMAL; the schema defines it as VARCHAR(50), so non-numeric values would cause an error or be coerced to NULL

alternatives.interpretation: Only include orders that have at least one non-NULL product_quantity value, excluding orders where all quantities are missing
